events.verdict: Doncic (LAL) moves laterally in a defensive position in front of Brunson (NYK) and the body contact is marginal. He then makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Brunson.
Doncic (LAL) is called for a delay of game.
Hart (NYK) swipes to dislodge the ball away but the contact that occurs with Dončić's (LAL) right arm is marginal.
James (LAL) goes to, but not through Brunson's (NYK) space following the release of his pass.
Doncic (LAL) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.

Hayes (LAL) reaches in and initiates contact with Brunson's (NYK) left arm, which affects his SQBR during the driving shot attempt. The contact occurs after Brunson's gather and continuation is correctly granted.
Anunoby (NYK) engages with Hayes (LAL) during the pick and marginal contact occurs before the two disengage.
Hart (NYK) brings a hand onto Hayes' (LAL) back but does not deliver contact as the rebound sails over Hayes head. The contact that occurs is marginal.
Although Towns (NYK) initially has a hand on the ball, it slides off onto James' (LAL) left arm and affects his ability to secure the rebound.
Bridges (NYK) releases the inbounds pass within 5 seconds.
Brunson (NYK) attempts to split between Finney-Smith (LAL) and Vincent (LAL) and marginal leg to leg contact occurs with Vincent as he passes the ball away.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is confirmed that Hart (NYK) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
Anunoby (NYK) and Hayes (LAL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal body contact occurs during the rebound.
Dončić (LAL) reaches across Brunson's (NYK) path but the contact that occurs during the drive is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Reaves (LAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Reaves moves laterally into Brunson's (NYK) path and is not in a legal guarding position when the contact occurs.
Robinson (NYK) attempts to commit a take foul on Doncic (LAL) away from the play.
Robinson (NYK) commits a take foul on James (LAL).
Towns (NYK) swipes down across Hayes' (LAL) arms and initiates contact that affects his play at the basket.
Towns (NYK) initiates contact with James' (LAL) right arm, which affects his ability to secure the rebound.
James (LAL) brushes Towns' (NYK) left arm as he reaches at the ball and the contact is marginal.
Hayes (LAL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Hayes (LAL) turns in the air and initiates more than marginal contact with Anunoby's (NYK) body during his driving shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) and Finney-Smith (LAL) engage during the rebound and Towns is not in a position to reach the ball.
McBride (NYK) comes up through James' (LAL) left arm to reach for the ball, making more than marginal contact.
Reaves (LAL) legally contests McBride's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
